w10_T4_003201: On Monday morning the Brackley cannery filled 145 jars on its first line, and a second line filled exactly the same number, so 2 lines ran that morning. Every jar holds 9 pickles. The cannery has 14 employees on the morning shift. In the afternoon all of the pickles were packed equally onto 5 pallets, and the pallet bound for Redgate was rolled out to a lorry. That evening the Redgate pallet was split equally between 2 shops, and the corner shop took one of those equal portions. The corner shop already had 77 pickles on its shelf. How many pickles did the corner shop then have?
w10_T4_003208: At dawn the ferry terminal car park held 239 cars. Through the morning another 72 cars drove in. Around midday 171 cars were driven onto the first ferry. In the early afternoon 3 cars were towed away for parking badly. During the evening 48 cars were collected by their owners. How many cars were left in the car park?
w10_T4_003210: A sports club printed 156 raffle books for its summer fair and then printed 73 more. Every raffle book contains 6 tear-off tickets. The first prize in the raffle is a bicycle worth 200 pounds. Volunteers sold 311 tickets during the first week. A box of 25 unused tickets from last year's fair was then added to the pile, and the printer delivered 27 extra tickets to replace some that had smudged. How many tickets did the club have on hand?
w10_T4_003212: Ines began the term with 24 potted cuttings on her windowsill. She gave 19 of them away to classmates. Every cutting she kept grew into a plant that put out 5 new shoots. The greenhouse at her school is 12 metres long. She then bought 19 more shoots at a plant sale. Over the following year her whole collection of shoots tripled. How many shoots did Ines have by then?
w10_T4_003216: The Delvin bottling plant runs 2 filling machines, and each machine fills 161 bottles in an hour. The machines run for 6 hours on a working day. The plant worked 7 days in a row to clear a backlog. The supervisor writes every run down in minutes, even though the shift plan is set out in hours. Quality control rejected 775 bottles from that run and sent them for recycling. How many bottles from the run passed inspection?
w10_T4_003220: Farah earns 75 dollars for each of the 4 weekend shifts she works at a cafe. Her aunt gave her 55 dollars for her birthday. She spent 100 dollars on a winter coat. The cafe is open 12 hours a day. Before a trip abroad she changed all the money she had left into a foreign currency that gives 4 units for every dollar. A friend then handed her 61 units of that currency to repay an old loan. How many units of the foreign currency did Farah have?
w10_T4_003223: Aiden read 47 pages of a novel on Monday, 6 pages on Tuesday and 49 pages on Wednesday. He read 27 pages on Thursday and 76 pages on Friday. The novel is divided into 12 chapters. All of the pages he had read were then divided equally among the 5 members of his book club, so that each member could summarise one stretch of the story. Aiden's own stretch was photocopied 6 times so that everyone could follow along. The club records its reading time in minutes rather than in hours. How many photocopied pages did Aiden's stretch produce?
w10_T4_003227: A stationery warehouse keeps its pencils in cartons, with 116 pencils in each of its 8 cartons. A supplier added 29 loose pencils to the stock. A school order then took 838 pencils away. A dozen of the pencils are the coloured sort kept for the window display. The warehouse later received 35 pencils returned by a shop, found 43 more in a mislabelled box, and had 8 handed in by a driver. How many pencils did the warehouse hold at the end?
w10_T4_003230: A cinema had 160 tubs of popcorn ready before the first screening. The kiosk made 23 more tubs during the afternoon, and a delivery brought 80 more. A dozen of the tubs are the souvenir kind with a printed lid. Every tub holds 4 scoops of popcorn. By the end of the night 622 scoops had been eaten. How many scoops of popcorn were left?
w10_T4_003233: A youth hostel had 158 clean towels in its linen cupboard. The laundry returned 20 more on Monday. Guests took 169 towels over the busy weekend that followed. A dozen of the towels are the large beach sort kept by the door. The hostel then bought 68 new towels, and a departing tour group left 57 unused ones behind. How many towels were in the hostel's stock?
w10_T4_003241: At dawn a market gardener had 89 boxes of strawberries in her van. She sold 67 boxes at the first stall of the morning. A colleague passed her 44 boxes to sell on his behalf, and a second grower added 79 more at midday. During the afternoon rush 132 boxes were sold. In the early evening a cafe returned 23 boxes it had not needed. At the end of the day the boxes still in the van were shared equally between the 6 helpers, and Marek took one of those shares. How many boxes did Marek take home?
w10_T4_003248: On Monday morning a dairy co-operative collected 176 litres of milk from its first farm. Later that morning a second farm added 45 litres. In the afternoon a third farm delivered 58 litres, and a fourth farm delivered 58 litres as well. That evening the manager confirmed that 5 identical collection rounds like Monday's are run in a week, every one with the same figures. The co-operative then repeated that same week 6 times to cover the whole season. How many litres of milk did the co-operative collect over the season?
w10_T4_003250: A school council raised 92 pounds at its cake sale. Half of the money went straight to the sports fund, and the council kept the other half for a class trip. A parent then added 80 pounds to the trip money. The council spent 11 pounds on printing tickets and 73 pounds on hiring a coach. How much money was left in the trip fund?
w10_T4_003253: On Saturday morning a scout troop set up 5 craft tables, and each table was laid out with 13 kits. The hall they used has 60 chairs stacked along the wall. Around midday a parent brought in 15 more kits. During the afternoon session another 43 kits arrived from the district office. In the evening a departing troop donated 45 kits it no longer needed. How many kits did the troop have altogether?
w10_T4_003266: On Monday morning a warehouse packed 230 tiles into every crate it filled. By midday 7 crates had been stacked onto each pallet. During the afternoon 3 pallets were loaded into every lorry. By the evening 8 lorries had been loaded and were standing at the gate. The site office keeps 45 spare pallets behind the fence. A driver then added 10 loose tiles to the last lorry. How many tiles were waiting at the gate?
w10_T4_003272: A community orchard started with 87 young trees and lost 51 of them in a storm. Each surviving tree produced 6 baskets of fruit that autumn. Every basket held 5 kilograms of apples. The orchard shed can store 90 baskets at once. The volunteers sold 599 kilograms at the village market. The next season a bumper harvest of the same fruit doubled the orchard's remaining stock of apples. How many kilograms of apples did the orchard then hold?
w10_T4_003273: A print shop keeps 120 sheets of paper in each of its 8 reams. A leak spoiled 48 sheets, which were thrown out. Every sheet that was left was then cut into 8 small cards. The shop times its jobs in minutes even though the invoices quote hours. The cards were divided equally among 4 schools, and Beechwood School took one of those equal parts. Beechwood used half of its cards for a display and locked the other half in the store cupboard. How many cards did Beechwood lock in the cupboard?
w10_T4_003277: On Monday morning a soup kitchen filled 79 tubs on each of its 2 counters. Every tub holds 6 portions of soup. Through that week the kitchen repeated the same morning's work on 5 days. The kitchen freezer is set to 4 degrees below zero. In the evenings the whole week's portions were divided equally between 3 shelters, and the shelter on Bridge Street took one of those shares. A local restaurant then donated 54 extra portions to that same shelter. How many portions did the Bridge Street shelter receive in all?
w10_T4_003285: A model railway club began the year with 31 metres of track. Members donated 37 metres in the spring, 78 metres in the summer and 36 metres in the autumn. A dozen of the club's members build their own carriages. Storm damage to the clubhouse ruined 104 metres of track, and a further 19 metres were sold to another club. The club then bought enough new track to make its holding 9 times what had survived those losses. How many metres of track did the club own then?
w10_T4_003287: Early on Wednesday a courier had 75 parcels in his van. He delivered 21 of them before the morning break and another 52 during the rest of the morning. At the depot at lunchtime he loaded 75 fresh parcels for the afternoon round. Before the evening cut-off he handed 18 parcels over to a collection point. The courier logs his driving time in minutes, although his contract counts it in hours. How many parcels were still in the van at the end of the day?
w10_T4_003288: On Monday morning a printing works loaded 6 trays, each holding 71 booklets. Every one of those booklets needs 6 printed inserts, and the works counted out the inserts it would require. During the afternoon a spare pack of 37 inserts and 3 loose ones were added to the pile. The foreman records press time in minutes although the job sheet is filled in with hours. In the evening 664 inserts were used up on a rush job, and a late delivery brought 29 more. How many inserts did the printing works have then?
w10_T4_003290: Leila keeps the yarn store for a knitting group, and she started the season with 163 balls. She handed 121 balls out for a blanket project. A donation then brought 64 more balls into the store. Her co-organiser Sam took 13 balls for a workshop, which still left Sam with fewer balls than Leila had in the store. Moths ruined 9 balls in the cupboard. A shop that was closing down gave the group 34 balls. How many balls of yarn were in Leila's store?
w10_T4_003296: On Monday morning a garden centre took in 7 trays of bedding plants, with 207 plants in every tray. During the week 1407 of the plants were sold. On Friday morning the grower Anna potted up 56 more plants, and her colleague Tomas brought 71 from his own greenhouse, although Tomas had raised fewer plants overall than Anna. On Friday afternoon a landscaping firm bought 134 plants. How many plants were left at the garden centre that evening?
w10_T4_003297: On Monday morning a stationery depot stacked 8 pallets, each holding 191 boxes of envelopes. Later that morning 56 loose boxes were added from a returned order. In the afternoon the depot manager Ruth had every box in the building broken open into 6 bundles of envelopes. Her assistant Nils handled fewer bundles that day than Ruth did. In the evening all the bundles were split equally between 3 delivery lorries, and the lorry heading for Ashwell took one of those equal loads. How many bundles were on the Ashwell lorry?
w10_T4_003298: A cycling event began with 224 riders registered at the first checkpoint. A second wave of exactly the same size registered as well, so 2 equal waves were on the list. On the morning of the race 18 late entries were accepted, and 63 riders transferred in from a cancelled event. The organisers record every finishing time in minutes, even though the results board shows hours. Bad weather then caused 189 riders to withdraw before the start. How many riders started the race?
